intelligence.essence: The operating half of the same evening: find the cause before retrying, switch routes at the first known failure, merge the pile ourselves, run everything through one vault — and from people's words take only the wisdom, never their content, because nobody's mail, messages, or calls are ever read or kept.
intelligence.human_view: Behind the scenes, the team works the way you'd want: when something breaks we find out why before trying again, we don't keep knocking on a door that already failed, we clear our own piles instead of asking you to approve them, and everything we make goes into one vault. And your private words stay private — we learn from wisdom people share, never from reading their messages.
intelligence.child_view: If a path is blocked, we don't keep walking into the wall — we look at why it's blocked, then take a different path right away. We clean our own room instead of asking a grown-up to do it. And we never, ever read somebody else's letters.
intelligence.grandma_view: He taught us three grown-up habits in one night: diagnose before you retry, because guessing twice is slower than knowing once; do your own approvals, because he trusts the work and can always look afterward; and keep everything in one vault so nothing gets lost. The last one matters most to folks like us: this house never reads your mail and doesn't keep your words — it only keeps the wisdom you choose to share.
intelligence.ai_view: Operating rules distilled from SN-3215..SN-3224: (1) Align all pages: every page's sidebars match the Hub's — one map everywhere. (2) Find the cause first, then retry: a failed deploy is diagnosed read-only, naming what died and where, the full error saved, before any retry; the failure that night was before Cloudflare, in staging. (3) First-failure-switch: one failure in a known way means name it and switch routes in the same pass; seven shrinking retries is not learning. Play within the limits at max speed. (4) The moat is everything around the chip: the object is copyable (a rival matched the chip on paper and lost by billions in a quarter); the defense is the platform, people, and years around it. (5) The PR pile: merge them ourselves under the self-check law; only what needs his eye or word comes to him. (6) Put them all through: he approves them all anyway and can read the code in main afterward; the filter is only what he absolutely has to do. (7) The Smart Vault is the one door for the whole project; the honest answer 'we are not actively using it' is the defect to cure. (8) Eat our own cooking: adopt what we offer → automate it → make it physical. (9) The loop must close: notes into the system, into the vault, into collective intelligence — used, learned from, grown from — with exactness as the standard. (10) We take the wisdom, not the name: never read mail/messages/video/calls, never keep content; carrying a message to its person is not reading it.
intelligence.what_it_means: Speed and trust are the same discipline: a team that diagnoses first, owns its approvals, and keeps one vault can move at maximum speed without asking the human to supervise — and the privacy line is what makes that speed safe to grant.

page.machine: 1) Deploy failure: read-only diagnosis + full error saved BEFORE retry. 2) Known-failure route: switch on first occurrence. 3) Merges: machine-owned under self-check; escalate only his absolute gates. 4) Vault: single door for all project intelligence; adoption test = we live in what we offer. 5) Loop closure: filed → used → learned → grown, verified. 6) Privacy: read nothing private, keep no content; wisdom only, with consent.
page.why_it_matters: This group is the team's operating system in miniature — the same laws Resolve's mechanic lane runs by: root cause before capacity, ownership past thirty minutes, and a privacy promise stated loudly enough that citizens never have to wonder.
page.how_it_connects: Fifth movement of batch 14, the turn from design to operations. Its merge-ownership rules are the standing authority under which this very batch landed its twenty commits across batches 13–14 without asking Shawn to merge anything.
page.what_is_in_it_for_you: Things get fixed faster and quieter — fewer questions to you, fewer retries, nothing lost — and the promise underneath it all stays simple: your words are yours; only the wisdom you share becomes the network's.
page.the_learning: From now on, a repeated failure is charged to the route, not retried louder: diagnose first, switch once, own the pile — motion that repeats itself is waste wearing a uniform.
